run_stable_diffusion_training: run the stable diffusion training script with config files and GPU acceleration via command line
resume_training_from_checkpoint: resume stable diffusion training from a saved checkpoint file or log directory
create_datamodule_from_config: create a PyTorch Lightning DataModule from an OmegaConf config with train, validation, and test splits
configure_training_callbacks: configure training callbacks including image logging, CUDA memory tracking, and model checkpointing
setup_argument_parser: setup an argument parser with options for name, resume, base configs, training mode, and debug flags
